function.name: impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function returns the CompositeMonikerImpl from the given IMoniker interface

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IMoniker interface

function.return_type: CompositeMonikerImpl* - Pointer to the CompositeMonikerImpl structure

function.name: unsafe_impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the vtable of the given IMoniker interface is VT_CompositeMonikerImpl. If it is, it returns the containing record of the interface, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the implementation is to be extracted.

function.return_type: CompositeMonikerImpl pointer. It represents the implementation of the IMoniker interface if the vtable is VT_CompositeMonikerImpl, otherwise NULL.

function.name: impl_from_IROTData
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface, effectively casting the interface to the CompositeMonikerImpl type.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The interface from which to get the containing record.

function.return_type: CompositeMonikerImpl*, represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IMarshal
function.description: This function returns the CompositeMonikerImpl from the IMarshal interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used to get the CompositeMonikerImpl

function.return_type: CompositeMonikerImpl* - pointer to the CompositeMonikerImpl structure

function.name: impl_from_IEnumMoniker
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface from which the containing record is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: EnumMonikerImpl pointer, which represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if a given interface is supported by the object, and if so, returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the CompositeMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the CompositeMonikerImpl object from the IMoniker interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the IMoniker interface, decrements the reference count, and if the reference count is zero, it releases the left and right IMoniker interfaces if they exist, and then frees the memory allocated for the moniker.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the updated reference count after the operation.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_GetClassID
function.description: This function checks if the pClassID pointer is NULL. If it is not NULL, it assigns the value of CLSID_CompositeMoniker to the location that pClassID points to.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used in the function

parameters.name: pClassID
parameters.description: Pointer to a CLSID variable. If it is not NULL, the function assigns the value of CLSID_CompositeMoniker to the location it points to.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds. If pClassID is NULL, it returns E_POINTER.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if the OLE-provided implementations of the IPersistStream::IsDirty method in the OLE-provided moniker interfaces have changed their internal state. However, they always return S_FALSE because their internal state never changes.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IMoniker interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_FALSE indicating that the internal state of the OLE-provided moniker interfaces never changes.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Load
function.description: This function loads a composite moniker from a stream, initializes its components, and sets its left, right, and component count properties.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the composite moniker to be loaded

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream from which the composite moniker is to be loaded

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, an error code otherwise

function.name: composite_save_components
function.description: This function saves the components of a composite moniker. If the moniker is not a composite moniker, it saves the moniker to a stream.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker whose components are to be saved.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the moniker's components are to be saved.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If it failed, it returns an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Save
function.description: This function saves the state of a composite moniker to a stream and optionally clears the dirty flag.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface where the state of the composite moniker will be saved

parameters.name: clear_dirty
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether to clear the dirty flag after saving

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If it failed, it returns an error code

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_GetSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates the sizeMax of the object by calling GetSizeMax on each moniker within this object then summing all returned values.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: An interface pointer to the moniker object.

parameters.name: pcbSize
parameters.description: A pointer to a ULARGE_INTEGER structure that receives the size of the stream needed to save the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pcbSize is NULL.

function.name: compose_with
function.description: This function composes two monikers and creates a generic composite if the composition fails.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The first moniker to be composed

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The second moniker to be composed

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a moniker, where the result of the composition will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_BindToObject
function.description: This function binds a composite moniker to the object it identifies. It first checks if the result parameter is not null and if the toleft parameter is null. If so, it gets the running object table from the bind context and retrieves the object identified by the interface. It then queries the object for the interface identified by the riid parameter. If the toleft parameter is not null, it tries to bind the rightmost component of the composite moniker with the composite at its left side.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: toleft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface to the left

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the result

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can be a success or an error code

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_BindToStorage
function.description: This function binds a composite moniker to a storage. It gets the rightmost component of the composite moniker, composes it with the 'toleft' parameter if it's not NULL, and then binds the result to a storage.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the composite moniker.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context to be used.

parameters.name: toleft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to be composed with the leftmost component of the composite moniker. If NULL, the function just uses the leftmost component.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the client is to use to communicate with the object that the moniker identifies.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the interface specified by riid, which will be used to communicate with the object that the moniker identifies.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful; otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Reduce
function.description: This function reduces a composite moniker to a simpler form if possible, or returns the original moniker if it cannot be reduced.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: howfar
parameters.description: Specifies how far the function can go in reducing the moniker

parameters.name: toleft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface on the left

parameters.name: reduced
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface that receives the reduced moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the arguments are not valid, or other error codes if the operation fails.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_ComposeWith
function.description: This function composes a new composite moniker by adding another moniker. If the 'only_if_not_generic' parameter is true, it returns an error; otherwise, it creates a new generic composite.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the initial moniker

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to be added

parameters.name: only_if_not_generic
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the function should fail if a generic composite cannot be created

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the new composite moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns MK_E_NEEDGENERIC if 'only_if_not_generic' is true; otherwise, it returns the result of the CreateGenericComposite function.

function.name: composite_get_components
function.description: This function recursively gets the components of a composite moniker. If the moniker is not composite, it adds the moniker to the components array and increments the index.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to get components from

parameters.name: components
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of moniker pointers, where the components will be stored

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Pointer to an index into the components array, where the next component will be stored

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the components array and index in place

function.name: composite_get_components_alloc
function.description: This function allocates memory for components and gets the components of a composite moniker. If the moniker is not valid, it sets the count to 1. If memory allocation fails, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the composite moniker

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the count of components will be stored

parameters.name: components
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a pointer where the allocated memory for the components will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Enum
function.description: This function enumerates the components of a composite moniker. If the enumeration is successful, it creates an enumerator and returns it through the 'ret_enum' parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the composite moniker to be enumerated

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: Boolean value that indicates the direction of the enumeration. If it is TRUE, the monikers are enumerated in the order they were combined; if it is FALSE, they are enumerated in reverse order

parameters.name: ret_enum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumMoniker interface. If the function is successful, this parameter receives the address of the IEnumMoniker interface pointer for the enumerator object

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the 'ret_enum' parameter is NULL, or an error code if the function fails

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_IsEqual
function.description: This function checks if two IMoniker interfaces are equal by comparing their components.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: First IMoniker interface to compare.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Second IMoniker interface to compare.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_FALSE if the two IMonikers are not equal, E_INVALIDARG if the second IMoniker is NULL, or other specific error codes if the operation fails.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Hash
function.description: This function calculates the hash value of a composite moniker object by hashing its left and right components and then XORing the results.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the composite moniker object.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD variable where the calculated hash value will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_POINTER if the hash pointer is NULL, E_UNEXPECTED if the composite moniker does not have any components, or the status of the IMoniker_Hash function call.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_IsRunning
function.description: This function checks if a composite moniker is running or not. It also handles different conditions based on the parameters passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the composite moniker

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: toleft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left

parameters.name: newly_running
parameters.description: Pointer to the newly running moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be a success code, an error code, or a warning code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_GetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function retrieves the time of the last change made to a specified object in the running object table (ROT).

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: toleft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface on the left

parameters.name: changetime
parameters.description: Pointer to a FILETIME structure that receives the time of the last change

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_Inverse
function.description: This function inverts the order of the monikers in the composite moniker and releases the inverted monikers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the composite moniker to be inverted.

parameters.name: inverse
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the inverted composite moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if it fails.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_CommonPrefixWith
function.description: This function compares the components of each composite from left to right if the other moniker is a composite. The returned common prefix moniker might also be a composite moniker, depending on how many of the leftmost components were common to both monikers. For non-composite, it compares to the leftmost component.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the first moniker to compare

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the second moniker to compare

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface pointer that receives the common prefix moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It could be S_OK if operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if invalid arguments are passed, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, MK_E_NOPREFIX if no common prefix is found, MK_S_US if the common prefix is equal to the first moniker, MK_S_ME if the common prefix is equal to the last component of the first moniker, MK_S_HIM if the common prefix is equal to the second moniker

function.name: composite_compose_components
function.description: This function composes components by creating a generic composite of the components and returns the HRESULT status of the operation.

parameters.name: comp
parameters.description: Pointer to the initial component to be composed.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of components to be composed.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to the final composed component.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_RelativePathTo
function.description: This function calculates the relative path from one moniker to another. It also handles the allocation and release of memory for the components of the monikers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The interface pointer to the moniker from which the relative path is calculated.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The interface pointer to the moniker to which the relative path is calculated.

parameters.name: relpath
parameters.description: The pointer to the interface pointer that will receive the relative path.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_GetDisplayName
function.description: This function gets the display name of a Composite Moniker object. It first checks if the arguments are valid, then gets the display names of the left and right components of the moniker. If successful, it concatenates the left and right names into the displayname output parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the Composite Moniker object

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context used in this operation

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of this moniker in the composite

parameters.name: displayname
parameters.description: Pointer to the output parameter that receives the display name

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if any of the arguments are invalid, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_ParseDisplayName
function.description: This function parses the display name of a composite moniker implementation. It gets the rightmost component of the composite moniker and lets it parse the name, using what's left of the composite as a left side.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the composite moniker implementation

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name to be parsed

parameters.name: eaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters parsed

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to the result moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the bind context is null, or other error codes if the operation fails.

function.name: CompositeMonikerImpl_IsSystemMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the provided moniker is a system moniker and assigns a generic composite system moniker value to the second parameter if it is not null.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the moniker to be checked.

parameters.name: pwdMksys
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a DWORD where the function will store the system moniker type if the pointer is not null.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_POINTER if the pwdMksys pointer is null.

function.name: CompositeMonikerROTDataImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a Composite Moniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IROTData interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the place holder for the interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerROTDataImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to a CompositeMonikerImpl object from an IROTData interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to get the CompositeMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count to the CompositeMonikerImpl object.

function.name: CompositeMonikerROTDataImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the interface pointer to the CompositeMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the CompositeMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count. This value is intended to be used for test purposes only.

function.name: composite_get_moniker_comparison_data
function.description: This function gets the comparison data for a given moniker using the IROTData interface.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker for which the comparison data is to be obtained

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the comparison data

parameters.name: max_len
parameters.description: Specifies the length of the buffer pointed to by data

parameters.name: ret_len
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the length of the comparison data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code

function.name: CompositeMonikerROTDataImpl_GetComparisonData
function.description: This function gets the comparison data for the left and right components of a composite moniker. It first calculates the required size, then checks if the maximum length is sufficient. If it is, it copies the data into the provided buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IROTData interface of the composite moniker

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the comparison data will be copied

parameters.name: max_len
parameters.description: The maximum length of the data buffer

parameters.name: ret_len
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the actual length of the comparison data

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if the maximum length is insufficient, or other error codes if there were problems getting the comparison data

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query the interface of a composite moniker marshal implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, whether it was successful or not

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to add a reference to a CompositeMonikerImpl object from an IMarshal interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to access the CompositeMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the result of the CompositeMonikerImpl_AddRef operation.

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the CompositeMonikerImpl object from the IMarshal interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMarshal interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the release operation

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_GetUnmarshalClass
function.description: This function is used to get the class identifier for the composite moniker's marshal implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be marshaled

parameters.name: dwDestContext
parameters.description: Destination context for the marshaling operation

parameters.name: pvDestContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination context

parameters.name: mshlflags
parameters.description: Flags for the marshaling operation

parameters.name: pCid
parameters.description: Pointer to the class identifier

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_GetMarshalSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates the buffer size required to marshal a composite moniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be marshaled

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be marshaled

parameters.name: dwDestContext
parameters.description: Destination context for marshaling

parameters.name: pvDestContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination context

parameters.name: mshlflags
parameters.description: Indicates how the data is to be transmitted

parameters.name: pSize
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where this function writes the size of the buffer required to marshal the interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_MarshalInterface
function.description: This function marshals the interface of a composite moniker implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be marshaled

parameters.name: dwDestContext
parameters.description: Destination context for marshaling

parameters.name: pvDestContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination context

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags controlling the marshaling process

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_UnmarshalInterface
function.description: This function unmarshals interfaces from a stream for a composite moniker. It releases any existing left and right monikers before unmarshalling new ones from the stream. It then queries the interface of the moniker.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface from which the interfaces are unmarshalled

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be queried

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful; otherwise, it returns an error code

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_ReleaseMarshalData
function.description: This function releases the marshal data of a composite moniker. However, it can't release a state-based marshal as there is nothing on the server side to release.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the marshal

parameters.name: pStm
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the marshal data is located

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: CompositeMonikerMarshalImpl_DisconnectObject
function.description: This function is used to disconnect a state-based marshal. However, it can't actually disconnect a state-based marshal as there is nothing on the server side to disconnect from.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used for marshaling.

parameters.name: dwReserved
parameters.description: This is a reserved DWORD value.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the disconnection operation. In this case, it always returns S_OK indicating the operation is successful.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function performs a query on the interface of the EnumMonikerImpl object. It checks if the provided interface ID matches the ones implemented by the object, and if so, it returns the interface. It also increases the reference count by one when successful.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the EnumMonikerImpl object

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer where the interface will be returned if the query is successful

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_NOINTERFACE if the interface is not found, and E_INVALIDARG if the ppvObject parameter is null

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the EnumMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IEnumMoniker interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the EnumMonikerImpl object and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it releases all the monikers and frees the memory allocated for the monikers and the EnumMonikerImpl object itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface of the EnumMonikerImpl object

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Next
function.description: This function retrieves a specified number of items in the enumeration sequence. If there are fewer than the requested number of elements left in the sequence, it retrieves the remaining elements.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of the IEnumMoniker interface.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of monikers to return from the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: m
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of IMoniker pointers to receive the interfaces.

parameters.name: fetched
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG variable to receive the number of monikers actually returned in the array.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the specified number of elements were fetched, otherwise returns S_FALSE.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Skip
function.description: This function skips a specified number of items in the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of the IEnumMoniker interface.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of items to skip in the enumeration sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents success and S_FALSE represents failure.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Reset
function.description: This function resets the position of the enumeration sequence to the beginning.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an enumeration object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Clone
function.description: This function clones an IEnumMoniker interface. However, it is currently not implemented and always returns E_NOTIMPL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The original IEnumMoniker interface to be cloned.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the cloned IEnumMoniker interface. It is set to NULL since the function is not implemented.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the 'ret' parameter is NULL, and E_NOTIMPL to indicate that the function is not implemented.

function.name: create_enumerator
function.description: This function creates an enumerator for a set of components, either in forward or reverse order, and returns it through the 'ret' parameter. It also handles memory allocation for the enumerator and its components, and returns an error code if memory allocation fails.

parameters.name: components
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of pointers to IMoniker objects, which are the components to be enumerated.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of components to be enumerated.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the components should be enumerated in forward order (if TRUE) or reverse order (if FALSE).

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumMoniker object, which will be set to point to the newly created enumerator.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, or an error code (such as E_OUTOFMEMORY) if the operation fails.

function.name: moniker_get_tree_representation
function.description: This function creates a tree representation of a composite moniker. It recursively calls itself to build the tree for left and right child monikers. If the moniker is not composite, it adds a reference to the moniker in the node.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: The moniker to create a tree representation of.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The parent node in the tree.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a node, used to return the created node.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: moniker_tree_get_rightmost
function.description: This function traverses a binary tree from the root to the rightmost node and returns that node. If the root node has no children, it returns the root node if it has a moniker, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: This is the root node of the binary tree to be traversed.

function.return_type: struct comp_node *; Represents the rightmost node of the binary tree. If the root node has no children, it returns the root node if it has a moniker, otherwise it returns NULL.

function.name: moniker_tree_get_leftmost
function.description: This function traverses the binary tree to find and return the leftmost node. If the root node has no children and its moniker is not null, it returns the root. If the root node has no children and its moniker is null, it returns null.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: This is the root node of the binary tree to be traversed.

function.return_type: struct comp_node *; This represents the leftmost node in the binary tree. If the root node has no children and its moniker is null, it returns null.

function.name: moniker_tree_node_release
function.description: Releases a node from a moniker tree by freeing the memory allocated to the node and releasing the moniker associated with it, if any.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Pointer to the node to be released

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: moniker_tree_release
function.description: This function releases the nodes of a binary tree in a post-order manner (left, right, root).

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: This is the root node of the binary tree to be released.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: moniker_tree_replace_node
function.description: This function replaces a node in a moniker tree with another node. If the node to be replaced has a parent, the function updates the parent's left or right child to the new node. If the node to be replaced is the root and the new node is not a composite, the function replaces the root's moniker with the new node's moniker. If the new node is a composite, the function attaches the composite branches to the root.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to be replaced in the moniker tree.

parameters.name: replace_with
parameters.description: The node to replace the original node with.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the moniker tree in place.

function.name: moniker_tree_discard
function.description: This function discards a node from a tree. If the node has a parent, it replaces the node with its sibling and releases the node. If the node does not have a parent, it releases the moniker of the node and sets it to NULL.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: This is the node to be discarded from the tree.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: This parameter determines which sibling of the node will replace it in the tree. If left is TRUE, the left sibling is chosen. If left is FALSE, the right sibling is chosen.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: moniker_create_from_tree
function.description: This function creates a moniker from a tree structure. It recursively traverses the tree and creates a composite moniker from the left and right child nodes. If a node is not composite (i.e., it has no children), it increments the count and sets the moniker to the node's moniker.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: The root node of the tree from which to create the moniker.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to a counter that is incremented each time a non-composite node is encountered.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IMoniker interface. This will be set to the created moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, or an error code if it fails.

function.name: moniker_get_tree_comp_count
function.description: This function recursively counts the number of nodes in a binary tree that do not have any children.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: The root node of the binary tree to be traversed.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer that will hold the count of nodes without children.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the 'count' parameter to hold the result.

function.name: composite_get_rightmost
function.description: This function retrieves the rightmost component of a composite moniker. If the right component is non-composite, it is returned directly. Otherwise, the function traverses the moniker tree to find the rightmost component.

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: Pointer to the composite moniker from which to retrieve the rightmost component.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer where the left component of the composite moniker will be stored.

parameters.name: rightmost
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer where the rightmost component of the composite moniker will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_FAIL if it fails to get the rightmost component, or other error codes if other failures occur.

function.name: composite_get_leftmost
function.description: This function retrieves the leftmost component of a composite moniker. If the leftmost component is not a composite moniker, it is returned directly. Otherwise, the function traverses the tree representation of the composite moniker to find the leftmost component.

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: A pointer to the composite moniker from which the leftmost component is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: leftmost
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IMoniker interface. This parameter receives the interface pointer to the leftmost component of the composite moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_FAIL if it fails to get the leftmost component, or other error codes if it fails to get the tree representation of the composite moniker.

function.name: moniker_simplify_composition
function.description: This function simplifies the composition of two monikers by composing their tree representations together in a non-generic way. If no modifications are made, the original monikers are returned. If modifications are made, new monikers are created from the modified trees.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Pointer to the left moniker to be simplified

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Pointer to the right moniker to be simplified

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to an unsigned integer that will hold the count of the tree components

parameters.name: new_left
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the new left moniker, if modifications are made

parameters.name: new_right
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the new right moniker, if modifications are made

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the operation fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: create_composite
function.description: This function creates a composite moniker from two input monikers. If both input monikers are NULL, it creates an uninitialized moniker. If one of the input monikers is NULL, it returns the non-NULL moniker. If both input monikers are non-NULL, it creates a composite moniker.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The left moniker to be used in the composite moniker creation

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The right moniker to be used in the composite moniker creation

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: A pointer to the location where the resulting composite moniker will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails

function.name: CreateGenericComposite
function.description: This function creates a generic composite of two IMoniker pointers. If either of the input pointers is null, the other is used as the composite. If both are null, the function returns successfully. Otherwise, it calls a function to create a composite of the two inputs.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The first IMoniker pointer to be used in the composite.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The second IMoniker pointer to be used in the composite.

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: A pointer to the location where the resulting composite IMoniker pointer will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_POINTER if the composite pointer is null, or the result of the create_composite function if both input pointers are non-null.

function.name: MonikerCommonPrefixWith
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is supposed to find the common prefix between two IMoniker objects.

parameters.name: pmkThis
parameters.description: The first IMoniker object

parameters.name: pmkOther
parameters.description: The second IMoniker object

parameters.name: ppmkCommon
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker object that will hold the common prefix

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: CompositeMoniker_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a composite moniker. If the function succeeds, it returns the interface pointer requested in riid. If the function fails, it sets ppv to NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IClassFactory interface

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code
